set.body:
Defect: Revision 2 had the verifier and the profile as one slice; they close different defects, share no test, and each lands green alone.

Do: CorpusProfile (column map + declared encodings ONLY; code books arrive in P3) with a Checksum identity over its canonical rendering, on LexiconTable's ADR 0011 precedent: refuse an empty table, a non-finite value, two keys folding to one with different values. CorpusReader.open(Verified, CorpusProfile) -> OpenCorpus. Name it CorpusProfile, not Profile -- collides with interview.scoring.Profile (Scoring.scala:347) and codec imports both.

Tests: 'open reads only v.artifacts' is a PROMISE, not a type: open lives in corpus-intake, inside the private[corpus] tree, and nothing stops it calling Files.readAllBytes. Falsifier: an in-memory ArtifactStore whose bytes match NO FILE ON DISK; if open yields anything but those bytes' rows, the test fails.

Mutants (SD1 — each must die, recorded by name): give open a path parameter and read from it -> the in-memory-store test must fail. Drop the code-book binding from the profile checksum -> the identity test must fail.

Exit: Reading is bound to the verified snapshot by a test, not by a sentence.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S3, P2b-ii
set.title: intake P2b-ii: CorpusProfile and CorpusReader.open
